subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Post-compaction semantic fact-survival gate with blocking loss categories
one_why: Scores whether test_result/failed_approach/failed_outcome facts survive condensation and blocks committing a compaction that drops them, while deliberately letting transient errors fall - compaction quality becomes a measurable, enforced property, not a vibe; no anchor or prior subject verifies its own summaries.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Six-layer ordered compaction pipeline incl. post-compact file reattach and reactive drop
one_why: Nuance vs 7 prior compaction-tiering entries: layers run in sequence (microcompact bodies -> snip cap -> LLM summary -> recent-keep -> re-inject file reads for changed files -> reactive overflow net) so cheap layers reduce what the expensive summary layer sees.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Absolute-position prompt-cache anchors that do not shift as turns append
one_why: Nuance vs seeded id: instead of last-message or warming strategies, cache_control marks sit on the 4th/8th user messages counted from the front, so the cached prefix boundary is stable across turns; rationale is stated in the code comment.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Fail-closed 3-OS sandbox with read-only-workspace delegation option
one_why: Nuance vs seeded id: missing bwrap/sandbox-exec raises instead of falling back to bare sh (opposite of nanocoder fail-open), Windows gets a 446-LOC AppContainer runner, and readonly_workspace mounts the tree immutable for delegated read-only workers because shell read-vs-write classification is explicitly called unreliable; caveats: opt-in profile, interactive terminals intentionally bypass isolation (sandboxing.py:8-10).

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Reactive overflow ladder: peel API-round groups, shrink giant outputs, trim old errors, then breaker
one_why: On ContextLimitError the loop peels one oldest API-round group if it saves >=500 tokens, retries; at the consecutive-error breaker it truncates largest non-error tool outputs and drops old error observations before one final condense-retry, raising AgentRuntimeError only when even that overflows - graceful steps down instead of failing open or dead.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Stuck detector with intent-diversity, cost-acceleration, token-repetition and think-only signals
one_why: Nuance vs crush/kimi-code loop-detection: beyond repeating action/observation patterns it classifies each command's shell intent, computes intent diversity and failure rate to catch semantic loops, and flags escalating prompt-token cost or pure-thinking churn as stuck states.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Composite TaskValidator blocks premature FINISHED declarations
one_why: Inverse of cursor-agent's heuristic-task-completion anti-pattern: completion requires passing pluggable validators (test-passing, meaningful-diff, file-exists, LLM evaluator) over the task's acceptance criteria, so 'done' is an enforced claim rather than a model assertion.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: DeepSWE eval workflow in CI with frozen model policy and explicitly bounded paired Codex case study
one_why: Nuance vs 6 prior evals-in-ci: runs on release-publish and label-triggered PRs (not a mandatory per-PR gate), uses the external DataCurve Pier harness with Grinta as the agent under test and an external verifier - and the README forbids presenting the 8-task paired Codex comparison as a leaderboard score; clears the anchor errata verification-9 bar alongside every-PR mutmut (mutation-testing.yml:38).

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Command policy is shlex+regex heuristics but de-obfuscates before classifying
one_why: Still pattern heuristics, not AST (bashlex is a dep but used elsewhere), yet it collapses $(printf %s rm) / $(echo rm) substitutions and takes the worst-of raw vs normalized risk - one notch above the corpus's naive regex deny-lists, and the reason the safety score sits above nanocoder.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: ChatGPT-subscription Codex OAuth as the harness's own model transport
one_why: Reuses Codex App Server only for managed OAuth and the model catalog, then drives the subscription Responses endpoint directly so Grinta owns loop, tools, approvals and transcript - a genuinely novel interop shape (rival harness as provider plane, not as agent), but it rests on an unofficial chatgpt.com backend-api URL with unexamined ToS surface; port the shape only with eyes open.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Durable event stream: WAL-first enqueue, flush retry policy, persistence-health states, session lock
one_why: Nuance vs kimi-code entry: durability machinery is the finding - write-ahead before dispatch, batched flush with transient-failure retry, ok/degraded/failed health exposed at runtime, and a cross-process session lock; crash-window loss is reduced-until-flushed, documented rather than denied.

subject: grinta-coding-agent
title: Manifest-based workspace checkpoint with quarantine instead of silent delete
one_why: Nuance vs seeded id: restore moves unexpected workspace extras into a quarantine directory rather than deleting them, and a companion pinned ShadowGit dependency handles git-level history; no git-stash GC story like cline's.
